name: sandboxed-shell
description: Runs the agent's shell commands in an NVIDIA OpenShell sandbox that holds a copy of the project, instead of on your machine. If no sandbox can be reached the command does not run (exit code 125). CoCo CLI on macOS and Linux. Prereqs: python3 (3.9+) and the openshell CLI with a reachable gateway. See SETUP.md.
